status: Preliminary conditional screening; not Chief selection or VerificationResult

effective_configuration.status: Provisional analysis assumptions; not procurement selection or physical acceptance
effective_configuration.cost_scope: All purchased vehicle hardware/materials; excludes tax and shipping

mission.note: Preliminary energy envelope, not a dynamically consistent trajectory. Include climb gravitational potential energy divided by assumed 0.60 incremental efficiency in addition to powered phase estimates; do not claim descent energy recovery.

screening_limits.note: Engineering screening targets only; catalogue maxima are not proof of continuous thermal capability. Check worst-case simultaneous tilt and thrust demand.

coaxial.trim: Solve equal opposing reaction torque and required total vertical thrust; do not assume equal RPM when torque factors differ.
coaxial.status: Uncalibrated sensitivity cases, not measured loss bounds

electrical.note: Solve shared battery sag from both branch input currents plus auxiliaries; distinguish motor current from pack current. Preserve motor calibration parameters.

battery_common.note: All battery alternatives are hypothetical procurement envelopes. PyThrust synthetic example cell is excluded as product evidence. Conservatively estimate delivered usable energy using loaded voltage, not nominal energy alone.

vehicle_allowances.item: Altitude and local position sensing allowance

motor_allowance.mass_source: Actual catalogue entry weight_g, converted to kg

catalogue_policy.note: Search bounds are computational choices, not requirements or a diameter limit. Expand if results justify it.
catalogue_policy.handedness: Unverified; no candidate is procurement-ready without matched CW/CCW evidence

required_followup: Obtain dated supplier prices, availability, dimensions and continuous ratings
Select realizable transverse-control mechanism by recorded engineering decision
Check servo torque, speed, supply current and full-travel clearances
Measure complete assembly mass, CG and inertia
Calibrate coaxial thrust/torque and motor/ESC dynamics on a guarded test stand
Agree numerical simulation acceptance tolerances with the human

limitations: Reverse propeller uses normal-rotation coefficient table provisionally; equivalence unmeasured.
Supplier motor 40 A rating is 30-second limited, not proven for 300-second hover.
ESC envelope, structure, servos, electronics and AUD prices remain hypothetical.
Resistance and coaxial sweeps are not validated uncertainty bounds.
Static mission energy envelope is not a flight trajectory simulation.
Differential yaw authority and installed thermal endurance remain unverified.
